pose.note: angles in degrees from rest (bend, side, twist; meaning in data/body_limits.json 'say'); A = the joint's turn in rest axes, G = its turn from rest in the world now (quaternions x,y,z,w); pos/end in metres, character space (+Y up, +Z forward, +X his left); contacts = parts inside each other (m). Math: MATH.md

note: cards = poses in order; move = seconds to arrive from the card before (-1 = auto), hold = seconds still. In-betweens: scene.gd / MATH.md (natural = body leads, hands follow, smootherstep). bad_frames = frames with parts inside each other.
